Hi, I'm Mike, and I live in Queens, one of the five boroughs of New York. Last weekend my sister came from Ohio, so I was a tour guide for two days. On Saturday we took the subway to Manhattan. We went to the Metropolitan Museum in the morning. It was very crowded, and we waited in line for thirty minutes. In the afternoon we ate hot dogs in Central Park. On Sunday we didn't go to Manhattan. We went to Brooklyn, and we saw the skyline from the water. My sister wanted to see a Broadway show, but the show sold out, so we saw stand-up comedy in a small club. She loved it.

Hello, my name is Giulia, and I am from Milan. In September I went to New York for the first time. I didn't have a ticket for a Broadway show, and all the big shows sold out. So one afternoon I went to the ticket booth in Times Square. I waited in line for almost an hour, but I got a ticket for the same night, and it was half the price. The show was a musical. I didn't understand all the words, because they sang very fast, but the music was fantastic. After the show I took the subway back to the hotel. It was midnight, and the train was full.
